seoTitle: German Student Visa Blocked Account: Funding Evidence and Practical Steps
title: German Student Visa Blocked Account: Funding Evidence and Practical Steps
content:
A blocked account is one way to demonstrate financial resources for study in Germany. Check the amount and accepted evidence with the responsible German mission before transferring money or choosing a provider.

Confirm the accepted funding evidence

Read the responsible German mission instructions for your visa category. A blocked account is one possible form of financial evidence; whether other evidence is accepted depends on the applicable rules and your circumstances. Confirm the current required amount directly before transferring funds.

Compare the account terms

Check the provider, opening charges, ongoing fees, release arrangements and the procedure if the visa is refused or plans change. Read the transfer and identity-verification instructions carefully. Keep the official confirmation and understand when you can access the monthly funds.

Budget beyond the account

The required financial evidence is not a complete forecast of your actual expenses. Plan for travel, housing deposits, insurance and costs before the first release of funds. Check whether tuition or semester charges are payable separately. If using a scholarship as evidence, confirm that its amount and duration satisfy the specific instructions.

Official information

  • Official German study visa information

Ask when funds will become accessible

Read the provider’s opening, transfer, identity verification and release instructions before choosing an account. Note fees and the process for a refund if your plans change. Keep a budget for expenses before the first permitted release, including housing deposits and the journey. A blocked account is evidence of resources under the applicable rules, not a promise that the monthly amount will cover every lifestyle or city. Confirm the current requirement with the responsible mission and separate that evidence requirement from the cost of the course itself.

Relevant listings and guides on NextApply

To see how these questions apply to a real listing, review Fully Funded PhD Enhancement of Concrete & Mortar Mixes Using Graphene Nanomaterials. Compare its stated requirements with your own preparation and check the official source before applying.

You can also browse University of Salford on NextApply and the PhD positions category. Listings and recruitment windows can change.
